label: Best in Class
corporate_parent: Carlisle Wide Plank Floors — independent, privately held. Stoddard, NH since 1966.
manufacturing_location: Stoddard, New Hampshire, USA — single-source manufacturing

species_grade.description: Hand-selected Appalachian white oak, graded to Select & Better or Clear standards. Minimal knots, mineral streaks, or color variation. Custom grading sorts available.

board_dimensions.lengths: Random lengths, average 6-8 feet, custom up to 12'
board_dimensions.notes: Wide plank is the Carlisle signature — widths that create visual distinction from strip/plank flooring.

kiln_drying.process: Precision kiln-dried with slow-dry protocols to minimize internal stress and checking

finish_system.description: Factory-finished options available with premium UV-cured aluminum oxide. Also offers unfinished for site-finish (outside scoring scope). Factory finish includes multiple coats of UV-cured aluminum oxide for maximum wear resistance.

milling_precision.description: Precision-milled tongue-and-groove with tight tolerances. Hand selection reduces warped/bowed boards. Premium installer consensus on milling quality.

source_traceability.description: Single-source Stoddard, NH manufacturing. Appalachian white oak sourced from identified domestic suppliers. Chain of custody traceable.

performance_evidence.dimensional_stability: Good — kiln-dried solid, but wide plank (5-10"+) inherently more susceptible to seasonal movement than narrow strip. Requires stable indoor humidity (30-55% RH).
performance_evidence.refinishing_potential: Unlimited — 3/4" solid white oak supports indefinite sanding and refinishing over 50-100+ year lifespan. This is the primary performance advantage of solid over engineered.
performance_evidence.moisture_resistance: Standard solid — susceptible to cupping and crowning from moisture imbalance. Not recommended for basements, concrete subfloors, or radiant heat.
performance_evidence.installation_versatility: Nail/staple over plywood subfloor only. Not compatible with concrete, floating, or glue-down over slab.
performance_evidence.finish_scratch_resistance: Excellent — premium aluminum oxide factory finish provides strong scratch and wear resistance.

finish_warranty.description: 35-year residential finish warranty covering wear-through to bare wood under normal residential use.

structural_warranty.description: Lifetime residential structural warranty against manufacturing defects.

nwfa_certification.status: NWFA member — certification status to be confirmed in deep dive.

formaldehyde.status: CARB Phase 2 compliant — solid hardwood is inherently very low VOC (no adhesive layers).
formaldehyde.greenguard: Expected compliant — solid wood products typically pass Greenguard easily.

durability_evidence.warranty_claim_process: Dealer-supported warranty claims through authorized Carlisle dealers.

safety_evidence.formaldehyde: Solid hardwood — no adhesive layers, inherently very low formaldehyde emissions.
safety_evidence.voc_emissions: Minimal — finish is the primary VOC source (UV-cured aluminum oxide off-gasses primarily during manufacturing, not post-install).
safety_evidence.lacey_act: Domestic Appalachian hardwood — no import chain-of-custody concerns.

platform_disclosure.cross_brand: None — Carlisle is an independent manufacturer. No badge engineering.
